about: The source model of a FLAC file (spec/zarrify/flac.md §5.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/flac.md#53-elements>): the elements a parser emits, and the roles each ID3v2 tag, the fLaC marker, each metadata block, the frames and the stream play, each with the constraints a file must meet to have the FLAC convention's layout (spec/zarrify/flac.md §8.1 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/flac.md#81-the-stream>). The parser checks them in this order; projections read a valid IR and check nothing.

elements.about: The IR of a FLAC file. n is a tag's or a block's body's size, f a picture's fields' length and d its data's, L a frame's length, B its block size, C the channel count and T the samples' data type (int8, int16 or int32 by the bit depth).

id3v2/<k>.about: the k-th ID3v2 tag at the front of the file, k from 0; its extent the whole tag

id3v2/<k>/data.extent: (at + 10, n), when n > 0: the tag's frames and padding, opaque

id3v2/<k>/footer.extent: (at + 10 + n, 10), when the header's footer flag (0x10) is set

metadata/<k>.about: the k-th metadata block, k from 0; its extent the whole block, header included

metadata/<k>/header.extent: the block's 4-byte header: the last-block flag and the type, then the body's length

metadata/<k>/padding.extent: a PADDING block's body, when n > 0

metadata/<k>/data.extent: an APPLICATION block's data after its ID, a PICTURE block's picture (d bytes), or a reserved type's body, when not empty, opaque

metadata/<k>/seek_points.extent: a SEEKTABLE block's body, when n > 0

metadata/<k>/vorbis_comment.extent: a VORBIS_COMMENT block's body, opaque (decoded in the root)

metadata/<k>/cuesheet.extent: a CUESHEET block's body, opaque (decoded in the root)

metadata/<k>/fields.extent: a PICTURE block's fields before its picture, opaque (decoded in the root)

frames.about: the frames; its extent from the first frame's start to the last frame's end

frames/<j>.form: {geometry: {samples: B, channels: C, data_type: T}, codec: {name: flac, sample_rate, bits_per_sample}, recipe: [[src, 0, null]]}
frames/<j>.extent: (offset, L): frame j, j from 0, header and footer included

id3v1.extent: (size - 128, 128), when the file ends with TAG there

given.total: 10 + the size field + 10 for a footer
given.syncsafe: whether every size byte is below 0x80
given.byte: the first size byte that is not, when one is

constraints.message: the ID3v2 tag at {at} has no 10-byte header: the file ends at {size}
the ID3v2 tag at {at} has a size byte that is not syncsafe ({byte})
the {total}-byte ID3v2 tag at {at} is outside the {size}-byte file

given.at: the offset after the ID3v2 tags
given.marker: whether the 4 bytes there, before the ID3v1 tag, are fLaC

constraints.message: no fLaC marker at {at}

given.end: where the stream ends: the file's size, or the ID3v1 tag's offset
given.have: the bytes of its header before end (4, or fewer)
given.again: whether it is a second STREAMINFO, SEEKTABLE or VORBIS_COMMENT block
given.aligned: whether length is a multiple of 18
given.name: its type's name

constraints.message: the metadata block header at {at} runs past the end of the stream ({end})
the metadata block at {at} has the forbidden type 127
the first metadata block (at {at}) is not STREAMINFO: its type is {type}
a second {name} block at {at}
the STREAMINFO block at {at} is {length} bytes, not 34
the SEEKTABLE block at {at} is {length} bytes, not a multiple of 18
the APPLICATION block at {at} is {length} bytes, shorter than its 4-byte ID
the {total}-byte metadata block at {at} runs past the end of the stream ({end})
the STREAMINFO block at {at} gives {bits} bits per sample: FLAC's are 4 to 32

given.valid: whether its lengths fit its body exactly

constraints.message: the VORBIS_COMMENT block at {at} is malformed: its lengths do not fit its body

given.valid: whether its tracks fit its body exactly

constraints.message: the CUESHEET block at {at} is malformed: its tracks do not fit its body

given.valid: whether its fields and data fit its body exactly

constraints.message: the PICTURE block at {at} is malformed: its fields and data do not fit its body

given.at: the first frame's offset, right after the last metadata block
given.frames: whether the stream has bytes there
given.valid: whether a valid frame header starts there

constraints.message: no audio frames: the stream ends at {at}, after the metadata
the frame header at {at} is not valid: {why}

given.same: whether its sample rate, channel count and bit depth are STREAMINFO's

constraints.message: a variable block size (the frame at {at}) is not supported: only a fixed block size stream is
the frame at {at} changes the {what} from {from} to {to}
the frame at {at} is numbered {number}, not {index}
the frame at {at} holds {samples} samples, more than the first frame's {block}
the frame at {at} holds {samples} samples, not the first frame's {block}: only the last frame may hold fewer

given.longer: whether the search passed max_frame bytes

constraints.message: the frame at {at} has no end within 16 MiB
the frame at {at} (frame {index}) has no end: no CRC-16 holds before the next frame's header or the end of the stream (a corrupt or truncated stream)

given.samples: the samples per channel the frames hold

constraints.message: the frames hold {samples} samples per channel, not STREAMINFO's {total}
